decisions.proposed_text:
Tôi là Lucky Lilac.
Nhắm tới ngôi sao Turf, thử thách nào tôi cũng chịu được.
Mong được chỉ giáo.
decisions.reason: The character name is correct, but the player-facing surface label 草地 must use canonical Turf instead of sân cỏ.
decisions.terminology_basis: Locked Lucky Lilac is preserved; common.surface.turf requires Turf and forbids Sân cỏ.

decisions.proposed_text:
Vâng, tôi là Gran Alegria!
Dù 0.75 Mile hay 1.25 Mile,
nữ hoàng Mile tương lai cũng sẽ không thua!
decisions.reason: Preserve the source numeric tokens and render each 英里 occurrence with the canonical Mile label instead of localizing the first two as dặm.
decisions.terminology_basis: Locked Gran Alegria is preserved; common.distance.mile requires Mile.
